name: Excellency And Glory Of Christ The
overview: The excellency and glory of Christ are vividly portrayed in Isaiah's vision where the Lord is exalted on a high throne, filling the temple with His majestic presence and glory (Isaiah 6:1-4). The seraphim proclaim His holiness and the earth is filled with His glory, emphasizing His divine purity and sovereign authority (Isaiah 6:3). This vision highlights Christ as the King of hosts whose righteousness and mighty power to save are evident in His glorious apparel and strength (Isaiah 63:1). Together, these passages reveal Christ's supreme exaltation and divine glory as central to His identity and redemptive mission.
